protocol.gc: Enabled for timing; collect before each batch. Separate allocation passes stop GC for one batch, then restart.
protocol.aggregate: Median of three session medians; each session median contains eight batch means per variant/group
protocol.baseline: Original calc loaded from the unmodified engine, using the same actual Map, player actor and native FOV cache
protocol.variants: neighbors, heap and both share removal of the unused h_score table; both is the normally installed production method

limitations: One 50x50 real map; 24 unique real queries repeated across three loads.
All 818 walkable targets on this map were reachable; unreachable performance is synthetic only.
Measures warmed path queries, not complete AI turns, frame rate, GC pause distribution, Windows or hardware GPU performance.
Effect batching installed but the idle real map exercised zero mask draws; native combination fixtures provide rendering evidence.
